title_zh: 约好陪朋友练习展示开场

scenario.label_zh: 约定陪朋友练习开场以减轻难堪
scenario.goal_zh: 回应朋友对提问和出错的难堪，并约定先练习一分钟开场

context_zh: 两名朋友在一次公开展示前谈论紧张和练习方式。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Chloe
sentences.text: I did not ask what the instructions meant because I was afraid it was a dumb question.

sentences.speaker: Ravi
sentences.text: It was a reasonable question. Several people looked confused.

sentences.speaker: Chloe
sentences.text: Now I have to present tomorrow, and the embarrassment of getting stuck is all I can think about.

sentences.speaker: Ravi
sentences.text: Would some practice help more than encouragement right now?

sentences.speaker: Chloe
sentences.text: Yes. Could I try just the first minute with you, without an audience?

sentences.speaker: Ravi
sentences.text: Of course. I will listen once without interrupting, and then we can work on anything unclear.

sentences.speaker: Chloe
sentences.text: Thanks. Let me get my notes, and we can start with the opening.

targets.sense_zh: 愚蠢的；不明智的（非正式）
